about: The H.A.M. Storerooms' five guards (Misthalin piece 7 step 4b; pickpocketed, Pickpocketing.kt and HamStorerooms.kt). Each tile and type is mejrs's data_osrs NPCList_OSRS.json (NPCs seen on live, pre-Nov 2022) and the OSRS Wiki's Guard (H.A.M. Storerooms) page, which agree. The Wiki says they patrol; the routes are guessed: each walks its corridor end to end, waiting 3 ticks at each end.
